about: GENERATED MATHS QUESTIONS (owner queue item 6; owner 25 Nov: first-class @family questions, each template a fixed set of ten in Find under its DfE sub-topic, tools/gen-questions.js). One template per row: `id` (its version is a fingerprint of the template and its DfE node, worked out by tools/lib/qgen.js, never written here), (a country-neutral skill: each country file data/settings/curriculum/<country>/<subject>.json maps its sub-topics to skill ids in its `templates`), `answer_type` and `marks` as data/questions.json has them, `vars` (each a whole number drawn from..to, `not` values skipped), `where` (conditions the numbers must meet), `let` (values worked out from them, in order), `text` and `key` (written with {expression}; `key` is an answer key the site's own marker reads, js/find-marking.js markAnswer_, | between accepted forms, rule: lines as in questions.json), `typed` (how a child would type the right answer; each must be marked right) and `wrong` (a near miss; must be marked wrong). Expressions use the names above, numbers, + - * / % ( ) ? : < > = ! & | and the helpers in tools/lib/qgen.js (gcd, lcm, sgn, co, plain, fix, tight). A generated question's id is gen:<node>:<id>.<version>:<numbers>, and the same id always gives the same question. Read by tools/lib/qgen.js; checked by tools/one-gen.js.
